mapper.select: SELECT v.id, v.agent_id AS "agentId", v.version_no AS "versionNo", v.status, v.note, v.published_by AS "publishedBy", a.workspace_id AS "workspaceId", COALESCE(v.published_at, v.create_at) AS "occurredAt" FROM agent_version v LEFT JOIN agent_agent a ON a.id = v.agent_id WHERE COALESCE(v.published_at, v.create_at) >= #{from} AND COALESCE(v.published_at, v.create_at) <= #{to} ORDER BY COALESCE(v.published_at, v.create_at), v.id
